data.name: Create Employee
data.description:
References: https://developer.uber.com/docs/employees/references/api/v1/post-v1-business-organizations-id-employees

This endpoint creates a new employee record under an organization identified by its id. Partners submit employee details such as name, email, phone number, and optional metadata to register the user in Uber for Business. Once created, the employee can be associated with rides, programs
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an employee record within an Uber for Business organization. Agents can register employee identity and optional metadata for later business ride or program associations.
Use for: register an employee, add employee contact details, associate staff with an organization
Not supported: employee deletion, ride creation, program management

data.name: Employee create (admin)
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an employee through the administrative employee resource. The available fields and resulting behavior are not specified beyond employee creation.
Use for: add an employee, provision staff, create an employee record

data.name: Allows you to create new employees used in Xero payrun
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates or replaces employee data in Xero for use with pay runs. The PUT method may support a supplied employee identifier or a broader employee payload.
Use for: create payroll employees, add payrun staff, submit employee data
Not supported: retrieving employees, processing pay runs, creating other payroll resources

data.name: 従業員の作成
data.description:
概要

従業員を新規作成します。

注意点

  • 管理者権限を持ったユーザーのみ実行可能です。
data.evaluateGuide:
新しい従業員をfreee人事労務に作成します。管理者権限を持つユーザーが従業員情報を登録できます。
Use for: 従業員を追加する, 人事情報を登録する, 新規従業員を作成する
Not supported: 従業員の削除, 従業員情報の取得, 給与計算の実行
